page_title: PSG 4-1 LIL | PSG v Lille 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Lucas Chevalier comes off his line to intercept the corner from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG).
90+2' Ismaily (Lille) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' Bafode Diakite (Lille) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Francois Letexier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
87' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

84' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Lucas Beraldo (PSG), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
84' The referee awards a corner and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) goes over to take it.
83' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
80' Substitution. Gabriel Gudmundsson walks off the pitch and Ismaily (Lille) comes on as a substitute.
80' 4 - 1 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 4:1.
80' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Gianluigi Donnarumma.
77' A goal, which was scored by Bradley Barcola (PSG), was disallowed due to offside.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Kang-In Lee (PSG) is replacing Desire Doue.
74' Francois Letexier blows his whistle. Benjamin Andre (Lille) commits a foul after dangerous play.
73' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
68' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
63' The substitution is prepared. Jonathan David (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Chuba Akpom.
63' Substitution. Ngalayel Mukau did his best and is replaced by Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinha (PSG) replaces Joao Neves.
63' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Ousmane Dembele will be replaced by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG).
62' Here is a change. Nuno Mendes is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Willian Pacho (PSG).
62' It's time for a substitution. Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) comes on in place of Achraf Hakimi.
61' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
57' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 21:1.
54' Joao Neves (PSG) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
53' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short.
52' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

50' Ethan Mbappe bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Alexsandro (Lille) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
50' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) is about to take a corner kick.
50' Thomas Meunier (Lille) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Lille manage to earn a corner.
48' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
46' Half-time substitution. Mitchel Bakker (Lille) is replaced by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
46' Bruno Genesio makes a switch. Ethan Mbappe is coming on in place of Angel Gomes (Lille) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Francois Letexier starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+1' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Lucas Chevalier, who pulls off a comfortable save!
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Angel Gomes (Lille) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
43' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Lille get a corner.
42' PSG are ruled offside.
39' Thomas Meunier (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
37' 4 - 0 Goal! Ousmane Dembele plays a short, square pass into the path of Desire Doue (PSG), who bends a shot straight into the top left corner to make it 4:0. Fabulous goal!

35' A brilliant individual effort! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
34' Chuba Akpom (Lille) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
30' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) makes a strong challenge and Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
29' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.

28' 3 - 0 Goal! Joao Neves displays great vision and sends a pass to Ousmane Dembele (PSG), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 3:0.
25' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 13:0.

22' 2 - 0 Desire Doue sends a superb cross into the box. Marquinhos (PSG) latches on to it and from close range plants a header in off the left post, leaving Lucas Chevalier beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:0.
22' The referee blows his whistle, PSG are awarded a corner kick.
22' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ousmane Dembele (PSG). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

22' Joao Neves (PSG) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Lucas Chevalier is alert and denies him with a nice save. Now PSG have a corner.
20' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

17' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) leaps to meet the corner from Ousmane Dembele, but plants his header a whisker wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
16' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

16' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Desire Doue (PSG), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to PSG.
13' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG. The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.

11' Joao Neves (PSG) leaps above the defender and heads the ball goalwards from a corner by Ousmane Dembele, but his effort from the penalty spot flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
11' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) will take the corner.
10' A long ball forward to Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is intercepted. PSG force their opponents to concede a corner.
8' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Bradley Barcola (PSG) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
3' A pass from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is intercepted by Lucas Chevalier and the move breaks down.
2' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Close! Bradley Barcola (PSG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and PSG will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Francois Letexier will supervise the game today.
